notifications.name: Collier ras du cou classique de princesse britannique
notifications.danger: The product has an excessive concentration of cadmium and lead (measured values: 44% and 0.14% by weight, respectively). Cadmium is harmful to human health because it accumulates in the body, can damage the kidneys and bones and it may cause cancer. Lead is harmful to human health, accumulates in the body, can cause developmental neurotoxicity (only if exposure to children expected) and may affect breast-fed or unborn children. The product does not comply with the REACH Regulation.

notifications.name: e-Transit
notifications.danger: Gas may be released from the 12V battery into the vehicle cabin area. Inhalation of the released gas may cause adverse health effects to the cabin occupants and cause an accident. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
